account_action_token.name: account_action_token
account_action_token.value: ("account_actions"."purpose"='password_changed' and "account_actions"."token_hash" is null) or ("account_actions"."purpose"<>'password_changed' and "account_actions"."token_hash" is not null and length("account_actions"."token_hash")=64)

account_action_lease.name: account_action_lease
account_action_lease.value: ("account_actions"."delivery_state"='processing' and "account_actions"."lease_token" is not null and "account_actions"."lease_until" is not null) or ("account_actions"."delivery_state"<>'processing' and "account_actions"."lease_token" is null and "account_actions"."lease_until" is null)

delivery_confirmation_lease.name: delivery_confirmation_lease
delivery_confirmation_lease.value: ("delivery_confirmations"."delivery_state"='processing' and "delivery_confirmations"."lease_token" is not null and "delivery_confirmations"."lease_until" is not null) or ("delivery_confirmations"."delivery_state"<>'processing' and "delivery_confirmations"."lease_token" is null and "delivery_confirmations"."lease_until" is null)

idempotency_requests_lease.name: idempotency_requests_lease
idempotency_requests_lease.value: ("idempotency_requests"."lease_token" is null and "idempotency_requests"."lease_until" is null) or ("idempotency_requests"."state"='pending' and "idempotency_requests"."lease_token" is not null and "idempotency_requests"."lease_until" is not null)

idempotency_requests_response.name: idempotency_requests_response
idempotency_requests_response.value: ("idempotency_requests"."state"='completed' and ("idempotency_requests"."response" is not null or "idempotency_requests"."scrubbed_at" is not null)) or ("idempotency_requests"."state"='pending' and "idempotency_requests"."response" is null)

notification_outbox_lease.name: notification_outbox_lease
notification_outbox_lease.value: ("notification_outbox"."state" = 'processing' and "notification_outbox"."lease_token" is not null and "notification_outbox"."lease_until" is not null) or ("notification_outbox"."state" <> 'processing' and "notification_outbox"."lease_token" is null and "notification_outbox"."lease_until" is null)

payments_unresolved_review_idx.name: payments_unresolved_review_idx
payments_unresolved_review_idx.where: "payments"."review_reason" is not null and "payments"."refund_id" is null

columns.expression:
(case when "status"='delivered' then "actual_delivery"
      when "status"='cancelled' then "updated_at" when "status"='failed' and "return_state"='received' then "returned_at" end)

shipments_driver_active_page_idx.name: shipments_driver_active_page_idx
shipments_driver_active_page_idx.where: "shipments"."status" not in ('delivered','failed','cancelled') or ("shipments"."status"='failed' and "shipments"."actual_pickup" is not null and "shipments"."return_state"<>'received')
